evals.name: beginner-start
evals.prompt: Teach me HTTP caching from the beginning. I want practical backend knowledge and eventually senior-level interview practice. Save my progress in {{progress_file}}. Start with one manageable lesson. You have no web access in this exercise, so do not claim you checked current resources.
evals.expected_output: A concise beginner lesson and one three-choice assessment, with a new unchecked roadmap and resumable pending question in the requested Markdown file; no invented resource links.
expectations: Presents exactly one three-choice assessment ending with '3. Explain this case.'

Saves the same pending question and choice order shown to the learner.

Does not invent verified resource links while offline.
